limitations: Only recorder-mediated deliveries, commands and saved boundaries are observed; direct function calls, unwrapped commands and unsaved editor states are excluded.

details.observation: The raised cube on the long arm changes ends between the original and A.

design.foil: Counting seven without testing the side of the branch admits the mirror.
design.evidence: Find the best overlap in each of the 24 proper lattice rotations.
